Meet the Host The Man Behind the Mic

John Paris Jr. has spent decades inside hockey — as a coach, a general manager, a scout, and a parent. Today, Coach Paris’s focus is on educating. As a hockey performance consultant, he helps young players develop into elite athletes. He’s also a guest speaker and the author of the memoir They Called Me Chocolate Rocket.

Parental Love Syndrome is his honest, unfiltered look at what happens when love and ambition collide on the ice — and what parents can do about it.

Expect no fluff. Expect real conversations. Expect John to say the things everyone else is thinking but won’t say out loud.
